text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Right now, a suggestion has come up to 
hold an inter-committee relay race to 
deepen bonds among the various committees.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"The unique rule of this relay is that 
instead of a baton, you carry an item 
related to your committee."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um... If it's the library committee, it 
means running while holding a "book", I 
suppose?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Right. How about the other committees? Do 
you have any ideas for what to use as a 
baton?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
In that case, would the health committee 
be a 'thermometer', I wonder~?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Would a 'dustcloth' suit the 
Beautification Committee? A 'broom' sounds 
good too!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, in that case, a "laptop" would 
probably be best for the general affairs 
committee.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? I-It seems like it'd be awful if you 
dropped and broke it, are you sure you're 
okay...?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Anticipating such accidents, we've used 
ones from the start that will not break 
even if dropped from a height of 10 
meters."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Incredible...! To think there are 
computers that durable...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
For the disciplinary committee, it's gotta 
be a bamboo sword! A pure and upright 
blade to cut down breaches of discipline!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, brandishing a shinai while 
sprinting in a race might actually be 
interpreted as disturbing public morals 
instead..."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
No way!? ...Gah, but if that's the case, 
what else can we use as a baton...!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It's all right~ Let's all think about it 
together~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Worthy of the baton, or unworthy— Passing 
through the central plaza, I overheard 
Symboli Rudolf and the others discussing 
such matters.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
What kind of work does the disciplinary 
committee usually do~?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"I'm keeping a sharp eye on Golshi to make 
sure she doesn't pull anything weird!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Gratitude beyond measure, truly.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
The rest is just morning greetings, 
uniform checks, and patrolling to make 
sure curfew is kept, basically!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
They're all important, but tying them into 
a baton might be a little tricky~.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I make any students who break the 
school rules write reflection papers, sir!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
In other words, the Disciplinary Committee 
runs while holding "Letters of 
Reflection"?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, no! That makes it sound like the 
Disciplinary Committee did something 
wrong!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Then, how about writing 'This is not an 
apology letter' in big letters on the 
apology letter...?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Making up excuses is just gonna make me 
look even more suspicious, isn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Hmph…… I'd like a few more opinions here. 
In that case—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Do you have any ideas as well? What do you 
think would be fitting as a baton to serve 
as the symbol of the Disciplinary 
Committee?
choice_data_list: Want to have Gold Ship run alongside you?

Let's make our "passion" for public morals 
our baton!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's not even a baton anymore, and 
there's a chance Golshi won't even show up 
on the day!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Well, it *is* Golshi-san...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, refusing to fit inside any 
box—literally— is just who Gold Ship is, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Golshi always goes way beyond anything we 
could ever imagine!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"I want everyone to help me figure out how 
to stop Golshi!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: That might be... a difficult question...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"After that, the topic shifted to 'How to 
Stop Gold Ship,' and the discussion 
drifted further and further away from the 
baton."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: “Feelings”...?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOO~H! I got it! I definitely feel that 
deep down in my heart, ssir!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Still, with that, would everyone around 
us understand that we passed the baton to 
the next runner...?"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
In that case, how about we write 
"Feelings" on cardboard and use it as a 
baton~!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hold on a sec! The Disciplinary 
Committee's 'feelings' can't be expressed 
with just cardboard!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... If cardboard won't work, maybe 
Japanese washi paper...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the discussion continued over how 
to turn our "feelings" into a baton.
